FAMILY_CREST.title: Family Crest
FAMILY_CREST.description:
Your first combat is replaced by a shop.
After each elite combat, a shop opens.
Whenever you visit a shop, gain [blue]50[/blue] gold.
FAMILY_CREST.flavor: Closed doors are made for those with the right family name.
FAMILY_HONOR.title: Family Honor
FAMILY_HONOR.description:
Your first combat is replaced by a shop.
After each elite combat, a shop opens.
Shop prices are reduced by [blue]20%[/blue].
Whenever you visit a shop, gain [blue]100[/blue] gold.
FAMILY_HONOR.flavor: Honor is not a title. It is the line on the bill you can always pay.
